notes.title: DEV PATCHNOTE
notes.notes:
Clint City,
Here is an update that will draw on the potential of the “World” redesign.
You will notice that, upon entering the game, things are clearer and friendlier, with a simple access to the game's main sections.
The PLAY button moves to the center and will take you to the GAME MODES page. The latter has also been entirely redesigned and will tell you, at a glance, what the different modes are and which Daily Boxes have yet to be completed...

Indeed, the big change is that EACH game mode (except for Dojo, Arcade and Event) now has its own Daily Box.
For simplicity, we have removed the Daily Boxes devoted to EFC zones and put in the prizes right into the rankings and all the Daily Boxes!
In order to collect the Daily Box rewards, all you will need to do is fight 5 battles in each room.
They will be available every day but the difference is that, from now on, there will be 6 of them!

Another very important new feature is your Missions tracker!
From now on, you will be able to follow the Missions more closely since, as each of your Missions progresses, you will see it in real time.
On the results page, after each battle, the “Missions” button will show you your latest Missions, whether in progress or completed, and you will be able to collect your rewards at any time. The summary of your rewards will always be available in your emails, in the “Notifications” section. That way, you won't miss a thing.

Another last bit of news, while we're on the subject of notifications, is that they will show up to let you know that something is happening at a given place in the game!


Happy gaming!

notes.title: Mythic
notes.notes:
"Greem to the Judge: “We arrived in the Saloon and ordered a “Blue Whisky” to celebrate our departure. But just then, this big guy with an icy look in his eyes – no doubt one of your henchmen – interrupted us. 
He was demanding we give him Tokenz, even though we’d already paid! Spyke lost his cool and things got out of hand… tables being overturned and that sort of thing. I managed to get out of the Saloon unharmed but Spyke got caught by your guys. So, Judge, where is he now??”
The Judge: “As you can see I’m still caught up in the paperwork, and I've got BETTER things to do with my time, so take a ticket like everyone else and we'll see what we can do. If I’ve got time, I’ll ask the Sergeant if he knows anything about your friend, but believe you me, if he provoked “Angel Eye”, I’d be amazed if he’s still alive. There’s a strong chance I’ll see your Spyke coming down this corridor AHHHHHHH hahhha!”


Kerozinn had also recently retired and spent most of her time big game hunting.
Although even with her animal instinct, she couldn’t have imagined that she’d come up against a beast of that sort in the middle of the Saudi Desert… and it was unfortunately there that her katana swords were later found by one of the surviving Raptors…"
Collector Friends, here are the two new Mythic cards. As of today, they'll be sporting their new emerald skins and will be available on the Market once again from Wednesday onwards! Just to remind you, MT cards are the rarest cards in the game. They’re no longer distributed and are only periodically available as rewards for the EFC Season or special EVENTS. Spyke and Kerozinn will therefore have a permanent, randomly allocated Clintz or battle points boost! So now, it’s up to you to enter the room and find out more! Happy gaming!

notes.title: Collectors
notes.notes:
"The results are in, my dear fellow: you're short-sighted", a sentence that still rings out in Bankee's ears today, the sentence that made him realize he could never again be a sniper.
But the real reason he’s retiring has to do with animal welfare. He’s realized just how important the protection of animal species is, particular that of polar bears. So now, he’s studying the species living on Mount Glatz and ensuring their protection.

“Beeboy the Big Brother”, the programme that turned the ex-community worker's life upside down.
Approached by Gail LD, the charismatic Beeboy left “the street” to devote himself to the programme that is now the new ratings smash by UppTV Cable.
But despite its undeniable success, Beeboy has still got just one, all-important priority, and that is his hood and his family.

Exhausted by so many years of trying to keep a reign on the tireless Piranas crew, good old Bloodh had run out of the necessary steam to keep those old sea dogs under control. It was when he had to ask for backup from the fearsome Captain Krook that our good old clan chief realized he was past it.
So, Bloodh decided it was time to change course and fulfill his dream. Having noticed the recent desertification of the northern part of the city, he stumbled across a rare gem: an old business that was now vacant and just the thing for setting up a rum distillery! What he didn’t realize was the type of crowd he’d encounter there…

Our 3 companions make the most of Clint City's carnival week to celebrate their retirement among friends. Planned leaving date, next week at 11am on February 12th.﻿

notes.title: Arcade Season 4: Apoc4lypse
notes.notes:
The heroes have managed to get past the wall of ice, that stands before the entrance to the Maze, unscathed... But the hopes of Kora Mail are quickly crumbling: in front of their very eyes emerges a labyrinth in ruins. Four menacing auras hover over its still standing walls. This maze was a quarantine created by the Creator at the dawn of the digital world to contain the dangerous programs of the Reboot. But when Forjoten fell, the final seal was broken and now nothing can hold back these imprisoned beings of chaos and destruction: they are free…and they know it. If the madness and aspirations of Nega D and Dokuja can be explained by the corruption linked to time and power, the programs held here have but one aim in mind and that is destruction. Tremble heroes, because the Knights of the digital Apocalypse have arrived!

notes.title: A Mythic Voyage
notes.notes:
Since Newell’s arrival, Dounia’s visions have gotten more and more intense, and an image of a place that is familiar and yet totally unknown, is becoming more and more pronounced in her mind.
Newell has clearly opened a breach into a dimensional doorway that doesn’t seem to be fully sealed.
Dounia senses something is happening on the other side and that she’s somehow connected to it. So, she’s asked her two friends, Scarlett and Manon, to come along and try and convince Newell to tell her about this place he’s secretly seen.
Newell quickly falls prey to the myriad charms of these two sisters, who surreptitiously pick-pocket him of the microchip that opens up this dimensional breach... So, now Dounia finds herself face to face with her destiny. Will she manage to find the answer to her visions? What is on the other side? And could the Oculus be at the root of all this?
With one foot already inside, the two sisters insist on going along for the ride with their friend Dounia. This adventure is really gonna be… Mythic!

notes.title: Arcade Update
notes.notes:
Hello UR players, 
As announced a month ago, here are the changes we made in the Arcade mode:

- Unlocking adventures for all seasons will now cost 20 credits each and a Continue will amount to 2 credits everywhere.
If you have already unlocked an adventure, you will not have to pay to finish it.

- Exceptionally, the first 2 adventures in Season 1 will remain free of charge. 
Their purpose was to introduce new players to the mode and we think that they should remain as they are.

- The bonus seasons will be deactivated next week.
We created the bonus seasons as an alternative method to winning Rebirth and Legendary cards. However, this was before we introduced the weekly LD missions. Now that the Rebirth cards no longer exist, we believe that these seasons serve no further purpose.
You have one week in which to complete the bonus seasons and gain all the rewards you are missing before their deletion!

notes.title: The Maze
notes.notes:
The Maze!
On the frontiers of the digital world, are forbidden territories dating back to the creation of the source code. The programs, and not even Aviria herself, never venture into these faraway worlds that harbor dangerous secrets. But after the war that turned the world against Nega D and the advent of Dragon Dokuja, certain barriers protecting the forbidden territories have been weakened. And this is exactly what has happened in the place known as the Maze: the labyrinth of quarantines where destructive programs dating back to the Reboot are held. There is no mistaking the signs, the digital seals are weakening and danger is close at hand. With the programs unable to venture into the Maze, a messenger of Aviria calls on the Heroes of Clint City to save her world and help close the labyrinth. Will you be able to find your way?


New for this season: 
You’ll have the chance to play the HQ free of charge provided you play it on the week of its release.
Once the week is up and as soon as the next HQ is released, you'll have to pay for the previous adventure.
The same will apply to the previous seasons in one month exactly!
Please also be aware that the 4 “second wave” unlockable LDs in this new season will remain exclusive to Arcade mode until the release of season 4, which means you won't be able to get hold of them through the daily LD Missions.
Happy gaming to you all!

notes.title: OPERATION PRE-STEAM
notes.notes:
It’s the big STEAM contest! To mark our arrival on Steam, we’re offering you a little photo competition on Instagram! 
https://www.instagram.com/urbanrivals_official/
Post a photo of yourself alongside this illustration of the new Riots character: Newell. To validate your entry, comment it with the following hashtags: #urbanrivals #gabenewell #steam #URiscoming 

20 entrants will be randomly selected and will win the new exclusive Steam character!! Good luck to you all!

The competition starts now and ends on October 18th; the date of Urban Rivals’ release onto STEAM!
